description: This file contains the implementation of the Currency class within the Opencart Admin Model Localisation namespace. It defines CRUD operations and retrieval functions for currency data managed in the OpenCart e-commerce system.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Represents the currency management operations such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving currency data in the system.

methods.name: addCurrency
methods.description: Inserts a new currency record into the database with provided data and clears the currency cache.

methods.name: editCurrency
methods.description: Updates an existing currency record identified by currency_id with new data and clears the cache.

methods.name: editValueByCode
methods.description: Updates the exchange value of a currency based on its code.

methods.name: deleteCurrency
methods.description: Deletes a currency record identified by currency_id from the database and invalidates the cache.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a currency by its currency_id.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCode
methods.description: Fetches a currency record by its code.

methods.name: getCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currencies with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCurrencies
methods.description: Returns the total count of currencies in the database.
